actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welcome to the Dumb Waiter Safe Operation Training. This module will walk you through every step of operating the dumb waiter correctly and safely.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You will be an associate who will handle these transfers. Press the Let’s Begin button when you're ready.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the Let’s Begin button to proceed.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Tap the highlighted Let’s Begin button on the panel.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Only trained and authorized personnel, Cafeteria staff or RME staff, are permitted to operate this equipment. Let's get started.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before operating the Dumb Waiter, you need to gear up. Pick up and wear your safety shoes, safety jacket, and cut-resistant gloves.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the safety shoes, jacket, and gloves and wear them.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab each PPE item highlighted and put it on before continuing.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Only trained and authorized personnel are permitted to operate the Dumb Waiter.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Confirm that you are an authorized operator to continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the 'I'm an Authorized Person' button to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Tap the highlighted button in front of you to confirm your authorization.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Dumb Waiter must never be used to transport people, under any circumstances.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Watch closely, is this worker doing the right thing?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look at what the worker is doing, then answer, is this the correct procedure?","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look at what the worker is doing, then answer, is this the correct procedure?","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before using the Dumb Waiter, check the availability of power. The power button should be in the on condition. Touch the button to confirm it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Check the power button and confirm it is in the on condition.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Tap the highlighted power button to confirm it's on.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before using the Dumb Waiter, check the floor indication light. We are in the first floor. Does the floor indication also match it?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: MCQResponseAction
actions.Data: {"questionIndex":2,"questionText":"Does the floor light match the floor you're on?","optionsList":["Yes, both show ground floor","No, they don't match","Yes, both show first floor"],"correctOptionIndex":[3],"showAnswerDuration":2.0,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look at the panel, and check the cabin's position and choose the correct answer.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Check the FLOOR INDICATION button and confirm the cabin's position.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Check the FLOOR INDICATION button and confirm the cabin's position.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let me show you why this check matters, this is based on a real incident.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"A supervisor and two associates were shifting coffee vending machines between floors using the Dumb Waiter. They were on the first floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The supervisor called at the lower floor without informing the first floor team. Let’s go check that out in the ground floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now this is where it got bad when the lift started moving down on call. Quick, let’s go up and witness how rest of the incident unfolded.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The second machine got jammed between the cabin and the platform. When the MST tried to force it free after pressing the emergency stop button, the cabin got freed and because of free fall started moving, and his arm was struck, resulting in a serious injury requiring hospitalization.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press 'I Understand' to continue once you've seen the incident.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Always confirm with the other floor and check the indication light before sending the cabin  never assume, and never force a jam. This is the reason why we have installed a curtain sensor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This immediately halts the machine whenever an object or a person breaks the light beam to prevent injury.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Unlock and open the outer door

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, let’s try sending the coffee vending machine to the ground floor. First the external door’s lock has to be opened. Push it up to flip it open.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good, now open the external cabin door. Keep your hands only on the designated handle, and open it gently","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the designated handle and gently open the secondary door.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Use only the highlighted handle to open the door.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before sliding the internal cabin door open, disengage the manual lever lock.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the manual lever lock and disengage it before opening the sliding door.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now touch the dumb waiter cabin door to slide it open.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch the handle to slide the cabin door open, avoiding the pinch points.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch the highlighted door to open using only the designated handle.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Place the coffee vending machine inside the cabin. Don't lean forward into the Dumb Waiter while doing this.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the material and place it inside the cabin, without leaning in.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Place the material inside the highlighted zone.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Notice this material is protruding outside the cabin. This isn't safe reposition it so it's fully inside before closing the doors.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Reposition the material so no part of it sticks out of the cabin.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Push the highlighted section of the material fully inside the cabin.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Close the primary sliding door. Make sure the manual lever lock is engaged, and keep clear of the pinch points.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Slide the primary door shut and make sure the manual lever lock engages.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Close the highlighted door fully and confirm the lever lock is engaged.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"With the primary door closed, engage the manual lever lock to secure it before moving on.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the manual lever lock and engage it to secure the primary door.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Close and latch the outer door

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now close the external cabin door. Keep your hands only on the designated handle.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You know the drill, the lock has to be enabled now. Can you do it by pushing the highlighted latch in?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the designated handle and close the secondary door and flip the latch to lock it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Close the highlighted door using only the designated handle and flip the latch shut.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"With no warning indications present, press the Send button to dispatch the cabin. Monitor that it moves in the correct direction, and confirm both doors remain locked while it's moving.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the Send button to dispatch the cabin.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let’s go down and retrieve the coffee vending machine.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The cabin has arrived. Flip open the latch lock to open the secondary door.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the designated handle and gently open the secondary door.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Use only the highlighted handle to open the door.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before the primary door can be opened, release the hatch that locks the primary gate.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the hatch lock and release it to unlock the primary gate.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now slide open the primary door, avoiding the pinch points.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the handle and slide the primary door open, avoiding the pinch points.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Slide the highlighted door open using only the designated handle.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Reach in and retrieve the coffee vending machine. Don't lean into the cabin while doing this.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grip the coffee vending machine and lift it out of the cabin, without leaning in.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Lift the highlighted coffee vending machine out of the cabin now.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great work here, let me close the dumb waiter doors for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we wrap up let's see what you remember. Sort these cards into what you should do, and what you should never do","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Think back through everything we covered, which of these keep you safe, and which put you at risk?","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Sort each card into 'Do this' or 'Don't do this' to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That's the full Dumb Waiter operation covered, wear your PPE, confirm authorization, check before you move it, and never take shortcuts with the doors or the warnings. Great work!","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}
